Even if you’re not typically the partying type, you’ll likely find yourself at a gathering or two once the holiday season comes around. Parties and other social gatherings can feel like their own ecosystems, all with their own sets of rules, hosting gift etiquette, norms, and expectations. This can feel daunting, but etiquette is rarely set in stone; the dos and don’ts of parties tend to shift depending on the time, place, and people involved.
